observations.behavior: The Gladly warehouse connector's retention window for event requests was reduced from 24 hours to 24 hours minus 30 minutes, while the comment was updated to explain this adjustment.
observations.posthog_connection: This change adjusts the start time of the first data ingestion window for Gladly warehouse connections. The connector requests historical events from Gladly; this parameter determines the earliest timestamp accepted.
